div.head: III Eg 4
div.ab: [Be ðon ðe mon oþerne forsecgaþ.] [Ld] And se þe oðerne mid woge forseccan wille, þæt he aðor oððe feo oððe freme þe wyrsa sy, gif þonne se oðer ðæt geunsoðian mæge þæt him man onsecgan wolde, sy he his tungan scildig, buton he hine mid his were forgilde.

And if anyone seeks to accuse another man falsely, so that he is injured either in property or in reputation, and if the second man can refute the charge which the first has sought to bring against him, the first shall forfeit his tongue, unless he redeem himself with his wergeld.

⁊ se þe oðerne mid wóge forseggan wille, þæt he aþor oððe feo oððe feore þe wyrsa sý, gyf þonne se oðer geunsoðian mæge, þæt him man onsecgan wolde, si he his tungan scyldig, butan he hine mid his were forgylde.
